name: Arik Product Fields
author: Tanmoy Biswas

sections.description:
Unlock the full potential of your WooCommerce product pages with Arik Product Fields, the ultimate all-in-one toolkit for adding powerful custom fields and checkout options to your store. Do you need to add extra product information, create a “Buy Now” button, or offer a product enquiry form? This plugin makes it simple, with no coding required.

Arik Product Fields gives you complete control over your product and checkout process. Effortlessly add a wide variety of custom fields to your products, create custom product tabs, and even add a pop-up enquiry form using your favorite form plugin’s shortcode. Our intuitive settings panel, perfectly integrated into the WooCommerce dashboard, allows you to modify the behavior and appearance of your entire store.

Built to be lightweight and 100% theme-friendly, Arik Product Fields is compatible with all major WooCommerce themes, including Flatsome, Woodmart, ensuring a seamless experience for you and your customers.

Key Features

  • 10+ Custom Product Fields: Add text fields, WYSIWYG editors, email fields, video embeds, and various taxonomy selectors (like dropdowns, radio buttons, and multi-select checkboxes) to any product.
  • Custom Product Tabs: Create a unique, custom tab for any product with its own title and content. You can also hide the default “Description” and “Additional Information” tabs on a per-product basis.
  • Product Enquiry Form: Easily add a pop-up enquiry form to your product pages. Simply paste your favorite form plugin’s shortcode (e.g., Contact Form 7, WPForms) into the settings, and a customizable button will appear.
  • Buy Now Button: Increase conversions by adding a direct “Buy Now” button that takes customers straight to the checkout page, bypassing the cart.
  • Advanced Checkout Editor: Take control of your checkout page. Hide the “Order notes” field, move the email and phone fields to the top, and manage the “Ship to a different address” section.
  • ite-Wide Display Options: Clean up your store by hiding the coupon field on the cart page or removing the “Reviews” tab from all products.
  • Theme Friendly & Responsive: Designed to work flawlessly with all popular WooCommerce themes, ensuring your store looks amazing on every device.
sections.installation:
Upload the arik-product-fields folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Arik Product Fields to configure the global plugin options.

For product-specific settings, edit any WooCommerce product and find the “Arik Product Fields” meta box below the main editor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

New Feature: Added a Product Enquiry Form with a pop-up modal, powered by your favorite form plugin’s shortcode.
New Feature: Added a “Product Tab Options” feature to create custom tabs and hide default ones.
Enhancement: Rewrote the public-facing CSS to be 100% theme-friendly and compatible with popular themes like Flatsome, Avada, and Woodmart.
Enhancement: Rewrote the public-facing JavaScript to be compatible with theme “Quick View” features.
Enhancement: Moved the settings page into its own tab under WooCommerce > Settings for a professional integration.
Fix: Solved a fatal error that occurred if WooCommerce was not active.
Fix: Addressed all security and escaping issues based on feedback from the WordPress.org review team.

1.0.0

Initial public release on WordPress.org.
